intentionalDifferences.managerRuntime: AgentScope 2.0 replaces the upstream Manager runtimes

localDisposition.dashboardQuickStart: replaced by the always-available built-in Manager admin console
localDisposition.legacyWorkerCredentialExtraction: replaced by Worker CRDs and Kubernetes Secrets
localDisposition.dashboardVolumeCleanup: not applicable because no standalone dashboard volume is created
localDisposition.dashboardVerificationSkipAccounting: not applicable because the standalone dashboard verifier is not shipped
localDisposition.legacyStoragePrefix: ported to both Bash and PowerShell installers with current and legacy contract tests
localDisposition.copawDefaultWorkspaceProjection: ported and extended for the supported CoPaw runtime generations
localDisposition.teamDagReconcileWait: ported as bounded convergence handling in the Team DAG acceptance test
localDisposition.workerStorageSyncIOAmplification: ported with successful-push watermarks, bounded incremental uploads, jq 1.7-safe config merge, and controller-only mirrors
localDisposition.agentLoopDocumentation: not imported because AgentLoop is an optional external project and is not a runtime dependency
localDisposition.releaseMetadata: kept fork-specific; the installer follows jesseedcp releases and retains the latest source-build fallback until this fork publishes a release
localDisposition.qwenpaw2Runtime: ported with QwenPaw 2.0.1 and local API configuration for models, Matrix, MCP, policies, agents, and skills
localDisposition.qwenpawNativePlugins: ported as image-bundled QwenPaw plugins for Matrix, TeamHarness, and Workerflow while preserving stale-response suppression
localDisposition.qwenpawStartupConvergence: ported by applying desired state only after the QwenPaw local API becomes ready
localDisposition.qwenpawTeamContext: ported with effective Team storage preservation and active-workspace context projection
localDisposition.managerDiagnosticConvergence: ported to the AgentScope Manager prompts and skills with a two-attempt bound and authoritative deletion handling
